items.title: Can Huang's Exit Create Chip Competition
items.summary: Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia is raising questions about whether rivals can chip away at the company's dominance of the AI semiconductor market. Bloomberg Intelligence analysts Robert Schiffman and Mandeep Singh say demand for AI computing remains strong, but Huang's exit could create opportunities for Broadcom, AMD, Google and others as customers look for alternatives and potentially push back on Nvidia's premium pricing.

items.title: Now Comes the Hard Part for the Stock Market
